verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only server-side MCP: Runway MCP and Dev MCP let external agents such as Claude, Cursor or Codex connect to Runway. Nothing shows Runway itself consuming third-party MCP servers. Characters' 'tool calling' is an adjacent feature, not MCP-client support, and gets no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
